title: BugFreeUmbrella script catalog
description: Machine-readable index of the catalogued scripts under scripts/. Generated by tools/Build-Catalog.ps1. Deprecated forwarding-shim trees are excluded from the catalog but counted in excludedScripts so that onDiskScripts always equals totalScripts + excludedScripts.

version.description: Standard revision the catalog was generated for.

generated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of generation. Not compared by -Validate.

totalScripts.description: Number of catalogued scripts; equals scripts[].length.

excludedScripts.description: Script files on disk that are deliberately not catalogued.

onDiskScripts.description: totalScripts + excludedScripts; equals the number of non-test .ps1 files under scripts/.

excludedPaths.description: Repo-relative directory prefixes excluded from the catalog.

countingConvention.description: Human-readable statement of how the three counts relate.
